rules.title: Anti-Eviction Act (good cause for non-renewal of residential leases)
rules.requirement: Landlords of residential rental properties may not fail to renew a written or oral lease unless they have good cause; the statutory good causes for eviction are listed in the Eviction section of the guide. Owner-occupied two- or three-family dwellings, motels or hotels, and transient or seasonal units are excepted.
rules.status_basis: Described as existing law in the DCA Truth in Renting guide

exempt_if.text: owner occupied two or three family dwellings

exempt_if.name: hotel_motel_transient_seasonal
exempt_if.text: motels or hotels, transient, or seasonal units

coverage.summary: Applies to residential rental properties generally.
coverage.exemptions_summary: Excludes owner-occupied two- or three-family dwellings, motels or hotels, and transient or seasonal units.

rules.quoted_span: No landlord of residential rental properties except t hose in owner occupied two or three family dwellings, motels or hotels, transient, or seasonal units may fail to renew any lease, regardless of whether it is written or oral unless they have good cause not to renew the lease.
